# kithd's installer font (T-0751): a 5 by 9 bitmap, one glyph per printable ASCII character
# from the space (0x20) to the tilde (0x7e), in that order, written by hand for this file.
# Each glyph is nine rows, top first, five bits each (1 is ink, leftmost is the first bit):
# rows 0 to 6 sit on the baseline (row 6), rows 7 and 8 are below it, for the tails of
# g, j, p, q, y and of the comma and the semicolon (T-1083).
# crates/kithd/build.rs turns the glyphs into OUT_DIR/site.rs; this file is the source.
